Question: Line \(\ell\) in the coordinate plane has the equation \(3x - 5y + 40 = 0.\) This line is rotated \(45^\circ\) counterclockwise about the point \((20, 20)\) to obtain line \(k.\) What is the \(x\)-coordinate of the \(x\)-intercept of line \(k?\)
